desc:
💸EARN CASH WHILE YOU SLEEP!💸

🔥Collect Cards, Earn $$$, Flex🔥 

How to Play:
🛒 Buy a pack from the Shop!
🎁 Open card packs and reveal influencer Cards!
💸 Place cards on your base to earn $$$ over time!
⚡ Collect your favorite influencers and flex your cards!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
